edits.headline: Pipeline explosion in New Mexico's Lea County kills two people
edits.subheadline: A second pipeline explosion in San Juan County caused power outages, KKOB radio reported.
editorialBody: Two people were killed in a pipeline explosion in Lea County, New Mexico, KRQE reported. A second explosion in San Juan County caused power outages, KKOB radio reported.
Isaias strengthened into a Category 2 hurricane heading for the US Gulf Coast, NPR reported.
Labour won the Holborn and St Pancras by-election for Keir Starmer's former seat, defeating Green Party leader Zack Polanski, ITV News reported.
South African human rights lawyer Navi Pillay won the 2026 Nobel Peace Prize, NPR reported.
India's foreign ministry called Vice President JD Vance's description of H-1B visa workers as "indentured servants" deeply offensive, Republic World reported.
Thousands of people rallied in Brussels against austerity, and police used tear gas and water cannon during clashes, Al Jazeera and Arab News reported.
